chunks: And by this chain of narration, he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Hasten to attend to your needs, for they will be easier to accomplish; accustom yourselves to writing letters, for they are more effective for fulfilling needs; and seek goodness near those with beautiful faces.
ai.seo_question: What are the three pieces of advice given by the Prophet regarding needs, letters, and seeking goodness?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Khisal*, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) emphasizes the virtue of promptness (*ibkar*) in fulfilling needs, linking it to divine ease and success. He further advises utilizing written correspondence (*kitabah*) as a tool for effective communication and seeking blessings from those with pleasant countenances (*hisan al-wujuh*), reflecting the Shia emphasis on social grace and practical wisdom in daily affairs.
